# Fincile

> Fincile is statement reconciliation software for bookkeepers and accounting firms. Upload a bank or supplier statement and the ledger export; Fincile pairs the lines that belong together, scores each match, and lists what is left with the amount at stake. It works from CSV, TSV or Excel files. A separate Shopify app checks Shopify payouts.

## What it does today
- Matching: exact reference, near-match reference, amount and date, differences on lines that share a reference, and groups of lines that add up (one payment for several invoices, or one invoice paid in parts). Each match has a 0 to 100 confidence score with reasons; matches below 75 by default are flagged for review.
- Exceptions workflow: likely reason, amount at stake, status, assignee, notes, CSV export and audit trail.
- Templates: bank vs ledger, payment processor vs ledger, invoices vs purchase orders, vendor statements vs payables, accounts receivable cash application, inventory counts, sales commissions, ad spend vs invoices, store orders vs charges, expense claims vs card statement. Payroll and claims templates exist inside the app but are not a target use.
- Sources: CSV, TSV and Excel upload. A read-only QuickBooks Online connection is in beta and not switched on; it has been tested against a simulated API only, not an Intuit sandbox or a live company. There is no live Shopify sync inside the statement product.
- Pricing: free plan (100 rows per file, 1 run a month). Paid plans $29, $79 and $179 a month. Billing runs in test mode, so nothing is charged yet.

## Measured accuracy (synthetic test files, not customer data)
Measured 2026-11-16 on six seeded, deliberately messy file pairs. Bank vs ledger: 98.7% of true pairs found, 2 wrong proposals out of 232, none auto-accepted. Vendor statement vs payables: 100%, 0 wrong of 198. AR cash application: 100%, 0 wrong of 81. Invoices vs purchase orders: 100%, 4 wrong of 142, all flagged for review. Payment processor vs ledger: 99.2%, 0 wrong of 119. Expense claims vs card statement (no shared reference): 62.2%, 45 wrong of 119, all flagged for review. Method and caveats: https://www.getfincile.com/how-matching-works#measured

## Security and limits
- Uploaded rows, exceptions, notes and connection tokens are encrypted before storage; the service refuses to store workspace data without its key.
- Fincile has no SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA certification and no independent penetration test. It is not set up for regulated health data or payroll files with bank account numbers.
- Details: https://www.getfincile.com/security

## Shopify app (separate product)
Finds Shopify orders marked paid with no matching payment, duplicate charges, refund mismatches and settlement gaps against Stripe, PayPal and payout CSVs. Page: https://www.getfincile.com/shopify. It has its own plans in the Shopify App Store. Live sync for Stripe and PayPal. Shopify Payments and 11+ other gateways by payout CSV upload.
